summary.text: Rosemary Brown is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 40 since December 1, 2022, after serving in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2010 to 2022; she is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Brian Wrightson.

paragraphs.text: Rosemary Brown earned a B.A. in communications from the University of Scranton in 1992.

Her professional experience includes executive sales management with Macy's and executive sales positions with Saks Fifth Avenue and Bon-Ton, followed by pharmaceutical sales with Hoffman-LaRoche and Vistakon.
Brown represented House District 189 from 2010 to 2022, and her Senate predecessor in District 40 was Republican Mario Scavello.

For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Judiciary, Labor and Industry, Transportation, Appropriations, and Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure committees, chaired the Community, Economic and Recreational Development Committee and was vice chair of the Local Government Committee.
